blocks.body:
## Current verdict

Nimbo is **not ready to scale acquisition**. The August 29 public-rank goal is unmet; the iOS 1.0.1 crash still lacks a symbolicated diagnostic report; the Open-Meteo clarification is sent but written promotion clearance is not attached; the exact `f97238b` Android phone AAB validates but has zero signature entries, the matching-source debug APK has bounded API 25/API 36 QA, and exact-current Apple simulator executable hashes are recorded, but those Apple products carry only ad-hoc linker signatures and protected private-signing operations for phone vc8 and Apple build 6 still fail, so neither surface has an uploadable source-synced artifact or matching signed-artifact physical QA; the 08:12 domain recheck still found nimbo.uz expired and undelegated, with no later registrar reply; and every critical weekly console guardrail remains unknown. The retained signed Wear artifact is current but lacks physical-watch QA. The reported Play conversion is above target, but its denominator must be reconciled before it can support a decision.

## Operating rule

Unknown quality, provider, release identity, domain, or physical-device evidence is never converted into a pass. External UI side effects remain action-time gated by the execution surface, and the zero-budget boundary remains in force.

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · restore diagnostic access, symbolicate, fix, re-smoke
gate_snapshot.evidence: Authenticated App Store Connect confirms one iOS 1.0.1 crash on 2026-08-25, but privacy suppression exposes no device, OS, crash report, stack, or UUID. Xcode Organizer also reports that a developer account is required to download the crash list, so symbolication and root-cause verification remain blocked.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Restore Organizer developer-account access or obtain the diagnostic report, then symbolicate, reproduce, fix, and re-smoke

gate_snapshot.evidence: Clarification was sent to Open-Meteo's official contact at 2026-08-29 06:05 +05:00 from the authenticated maintainer account; no written reply has been received.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Monitor the sent thread and record an unambiguous written response

gate_snapshot.evidence: Current product commit f97238b resolves to Android phone 1.1.0 (8) and Apple 1.1.0 (6). Its exact unsigned phone AAB SHA-256 a631c67df19761964d25dd6fbbdc89b7d9c0ee6d8544ebc23113bcee52043ed9 passes Bundletool validation with package uz.ganikhodjaev.weather, versionCode 8, versionName 1.1.0, minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, and 0 signature entries; mapping SHA-256 b25870ff3173eb6bccd0ee6bceffba098685d11aa828d27dc9f7a1965ec2c6c7 is retained. Exact-current Apple Release simulator executable SHA-256 values are app 67a99d6cfc04302c54aeb71fed0a78a6e3c6c9d9aaaca7bb4d0f1e13ed62bb58, embedded widget 3c65e9c8716a0f0426e19f2682b0d0ab1f1c0c0975106e773694d22600f72a4e, and watch app 75a329ed9ad25ae8fe25dcdb54afcd0b5828a9975d2056a9ec28bc079761713a. Those simulator products were built with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO and have only ad-hoc linker signatures with no TeamIdentifier; they are not archives or upload candidates. A matching-source Android debug APK passed bounded physical API 25 and API 36 emulator QA, but it is not upload-signed or a full release matrix. Android Keychain value lookups exit with status 51, and Apple private-key signing remains unavailable after errSecInternalComponent and errSecAuthFailed evidence. There is no upload-signed phone AAB, distribution-signed Apple archive, or matching signed-artifact physical QA. Unchanged Wear OS 1.1.0 (1000008) alone remains verified-current. See growth/quality/signing-readiness-2026-08-29.md.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Restore private signing authorization without replacing the existing identities, then create new signed vc8 and build-6 artifacts, verify identities and hashes, and record exact physical QA

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · current signed vc8 and physical matrix missing
gate_snapshot.evidence: Current product commit f97238b debug APK SHA-256 7b2f2c12d56fdda293f19317ef6eb6da153213f84b1daeef11fd35f8e9e30edb passed bounded current-source QA on the dedicated physical API 25 phone and API 36 emulator: onboarding, live city selection/search, share chooser, legacy navigation contrast, true-offline cache/error/recovery, IME resize, dark landscape, and process stability. The review prompt itself was not forced. There is still no upload-signed vc8 or release-certificate physical result, and physical tablet, widget, and Wear OS coverage remains required.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Sign and verify phone vc8, then run the exact signed artifact on phone and tablet plus widget and paired Wear OS paths

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · signed build 6 and physical matrix missing
gate_snapshot.evidence: Current Apple 1.1.0 (6) source at commit f97238b now has exact-current arm64 Release simulator executable hashes: app 67a99d6cfc04302c54aeb71fed0a78a6e3c6c9d9aaaca7bb4d0f1e13ed62bb58, embedded widget 3c65e9c8716a0f0426e19f2682b0d0ab1f1c0c0975106e773694d22600f72a4e, and watch app 75a329ed9ad25ae8fe25dcdb54afcd0b5828a9975d2056a9ec28bc079761713a. They were built with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO and carry only Xcode ad-hoc linker signatures with no TeamIdentifier, so they are not uploadable and provide no archive or physical-device proof. A current iPad has a compatible usable DDI and connected tunnel, but private-key signing still blocks installation; current iPhone, iPad, widget, and watch physical coverage remains required.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Archive and distribution-sign build 6, then run the exact artifact on iPhone and iPad plus widget and paired watch paths

gate_snapshot.decision: BLOCKED · registrar activation and registry delegation missing
gate_snapshot.evidence: At 2026-08-29 08:12 +05:00, domain-specific WHOIS still reports NIMBO.UZ as EXPIRED with creation and expiration both 2026-08-28; the apparent top-level ACTIVE line belongs to the IANA .UZ ccTLD object, not NIMBO.UZ. Cloudflare remains pending, but both assigned child nameservers authoritatively serve the staged DNS-only GitHub Pages record set. Registry authorities and public resolvers return DNSSEC-validated non-delegation, with no public A or AAAA answer and no resolvable HTTPS host. One registrar support follow-up referencing ticket 1665 was sent at approximately 07:45; no later activation reply, DNS change, or duplicate message is recorded.
gate_snapshot.next_action: Wait for registrar activation, verify registry delegation and the staged records from independent resolvers, then wait for valid HTTPS

gate_snapshot.evidence: The 2026-08-28 App Store read-only check found no open review/compliance action, and the authenticated Google Play recheck at 2026-08-29 06:24 +05:00 again explicitly reported no policy issues and no pending publishing change. See growth/quality/store-policy-console-2026-08-28.md.

accessIssues.message: Raw App Store Connect and Play Console exports with country, source, device, version, and denominator definitions are not attached.

App Store Connect confirms one crash on iOS 1.0.1 on August 25, 2026, but exposes no stack trace at this traffic level; Xcode Organizer reports that a developer account is required to download the crash list.

Current Android phone vc8 and Apple build 6 have no upload-signed artifacts or matching signed-artifact physical QA because their protected private-signing operations are not authorized. Android has an exact-current unsigned AAB plus bounded matching-source debug QA; Apple has exact-current simulator executable hashes, but those products carry only ad-hoc linker signatures and are not archives or upload candidates.

At the August 29 08:12 +05:00 recheck, nimbo.uz remained expired and undelegated, with no public A/AAAA answer or resolvable HTTPS host. Cloudflare's child zone still served staged records; the 07:45 registrar follow-up had no later reply, DNS change, or duplicate message.
All eight critical console guardrails lack decision-eligible weekly evidence; unknown remains blocking even though the separate point-in-time operational policy-console checks passed.
